wave4.scope: The stopping-distance / physics block — every row in the file asserting a distance, a time or a ratio
wave4.statusAfter: the 6 touched rows are needs-review (were approved); the 28 recomputed-and-correct rows were NOT touched
wave4.method: These are arithmetic, so they are decidable with no source at all. Recomputed from first principles: v[m/s] = v[km/h]/3.6; reaction distance = v*t with t = 1.0 s; braking distance = v^2/(2*mu*g) with g = 9.81 m/s^2, mu = 0.8 dry asphalt and 0.4 wet; total = reaction + braking. Every stated figure in the file was checked against this table.

defectsFixed: q-speed-009 — the explanation contradicted itself inside one sentence: it called 9 metres per second 'скорост на ходом' and then computed that 9 m/s is 32 km/h. Both cannot be true; 32 km/h is a sprint. Rewritten with the actual conversions (9 m/s = 32.4 km/h, 15 m/s = 54 km/h) and with the 1-second reaction time named as the teaching convention it is (real range ~0.7 to >1.5 s). Key (25 m) was correct and is unchanged.
q-speed-045 — same error class: '5 метра би било скорост на ходом'. 5 m/s is 18.0 km/h, a run, not a walk. Rewritten with the real conversions. Key (14 m) correct, unchanged.

q-speed-046 — the real one. The arithmetic was right (half the speedometer at 100 km/h = 50 m) but the explanation said those 50 m are 'колкото ти трябват, за да реагираш и спреш'. False: full stopping from 100 km/h on dry asphalt is 76.9 m. It also contradicted q-speed-042 in the SAME FILE, whose explanation says '~80 метра на сухо'. Rewritten to say what the rule actually is — a FOLLOWING distance that works because the car in front also has a braking distance, so you mainly need the reaction gap plus the difference between the two braking distances. Key unchanged.

q-speed-015 — 'Пълният път за спиране е в пъти по-къс, отколкото при 50 км/ч' was vague where it could be exact. Replaced with the computed figures (about 13 m at 30 km/h against about 26 m at 50), and the distinction that the braking part alone is ~2.8x while the total is ~2.05x. Key unchanged.

q-speed-014 — the marked-correct option says 'силата на удара' grows with the square of speed. Strictly it is the kinetic ENERGY that goes as v^2 (E = ½mv²); the peak force also depends on the crush distance. Key kept (it is the only option on the right order of growth) and the explanation now states E = ½mv² and names the qualifier instead of implying precision the word 'сила' does not have.

q-speed-006 — 'ако виждаш 40 метра, а ти трябват 70' implied a computed figure; the computed value at 90 km/h is 64.8 m. Restated as 'около 65 метра (25 за реакцията, около 40 за спирачките)' and the lawRef sharpened from чл. 20 to чл. 20, ал. 2, which is the alinea the explanation now quotes verbatim ('за да бъдат в състояние да спрат пред всяко предвидимо препятствие').
wave4.roundedConventionsNamedNotHidden: Where a figure is a teaching convention rather than a computation it is now said to be one, per the brief: the 1-second reaction time (q-speed-009, q-speed-045), mu = 0.8 dry / 0.4 wet behind 'на мокро почти двойно' (q-speed-038, q-speed-060), the 2-second and half-speedometer following rules (q-speed-016, q-speed-046, q-speed-056), the ~40 m dipped-beam / 100-150 m main-beam visibility figures (q-speed-053), and the ~50 km/h snow-chain ceiling (q-speed-047, whose explanation already said correctly that 'Законът не изписва число за вериги').
